instruction: I need you to create a folder called 'Important' on the bookmarks bar of the browser.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a bookmark folder named 'Important' on the bookmarks bar. Uses existing Chrome evaluator functions (is_expected_bookmarks with bookmark_bar_folders_names type). No custom functions needed - reuses official getter/metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads Chrome Bookmarks file from filesystem to capture persistent bookmark state
Metric logic correctly filters for folders (type=='folder') and extracts folder names from bookmark_bar
Expected value 'Important' correctly matches the folder name required by instruction
Metric uses appropriate issubset check - allows additional folders while verifying 'Important' exists
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure bookmarks are persisted to disk before verification
Complete coverage - evaluator checks exactly what instruction requires (folder named 'Important' on bookmarks bar)
No semantic or logical issues - evaluator can definitively verify task completion
